I am using it on R-3.2.2 Patched and had no problem.  Are you able to install other packages?  

Maybe try a different mirror.  Note that the mirror setup changed in recent versions of R to favour mirrors that support https.

messages.subject: Re: package ‘gsubfn’ is not available (for R version 3.2.2)
parts: That should not be necessary.  gsubfn is on CRAN and is available for R-3.2.2.

On Thursday, November 5, 2015 at 9:24:05 PM UTC-5, Claus W wrote:
Hi,

it finally work with:

 devtools::install_github("ggrothendieck/gsubfn")
